items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Because we did, if I recall on the Four Seasons recordings Frankie didn’t even sing, Frankie Valli of course, and they didn’t do their background, but they did put it on later on.

ctx.x: Sometimes you can say oh, that’s neat.

Because we did, if I recall on the Four Seasons recordings Frankie didn’t even sing, Frankie Valli of course, and they didn’t do their background, but they did put it on later on. He might have done a scratch track of the vocal if I recall that, he did that. And we did a lot of commercials too. In those days all the rock & roll groups and groups were doing commercials for different stations. Like, “Hi this is Frankie Valli for KTLM in Oklahoma City” and we would be playing in the background and then mix those up.…
How much did those, what was the studio rate at that time?
